claimBoundary: This draft allocates no capacity. LV02 needs its own measured calibration, pilot, and main/repeat allocation under the same global ceilings; this policy does not reserve future capacity today.

derivation.algorithm: deriveSeedHex SHA-256 over UTF-8 parts joined by one NUL byte

partValues.case: zero-padded probe case index within checkpoint

prohibited: reuse of development, qualification, pilot, main or repeat identities
reuse of any LV01 v1/v2, E00-E50, or other-study identity
derivation.rule: Every materialized seed is the SHA-256 hex of all applicable parts joined by single NUL bytes. Every identity must be unique across LV02 and collision-checked against all retained and registered earlier identities, including every LV01 and E00-E50 identity.
derivation.sharedPairing: Probe case identities and receiver action draws intentionally omit branch (single normal-delivery branch per probe case). Learner initialization occurs once per dyad; checkpoint probe identities append checkpoint and case.

generalizedSelector.rule: Generalize the LV01 v2 selector by replacing four family members/seven components with declared m/k: screening 0.05/m, pilot upper-SD quantile 0.05/k, Monte Carlo lower level 0.05/(6*k), union-bound lower power 0.90, twenty valid pilot dyads, six candidate Ns. LV02 has m=1/k=1.
generalizedSelector.selectionRule: Select the smallest qualifying N; if that N cannot be funded within the existing resource envelope, do not select a smaller underpowered N. Zero or nonfinite dispersion blocks selection.

power.numericalQualification: LV02 receives its own independent numerical and operating-characteristic validation with a separate implementation and prespecified bounded/skewed/mixture/degenerate simulation cases, including null/boundary type-I checks and stated-alternative power checks. A failed calibration stops registration and requires a new prospective methods decision.
power.reserveRule: Retain the one-sided 95% Wilson upper invalidity bound from the LV02 pilot and choose the smallest R giving P(Binomial(N+R,pUpper) <= R) >= 0.95 separately per main/repeat stage. Require the complete 2*(N+R) allocation plus overhead before main starts. Fresh-seed repeat uses the same N/design regardless of first effects.

resources.allocationRule: Measure full-workload LV02 calibration dyads only after the lifetime-iteration and capacity gates permit them. Reserve twice the maximum complete CPU/storage/wall cost and 1.5 times the conservative peak memory. Reconcile maxima again after the LV02 pilot. Include a fixed analysis/reproduction/packaging allocation. No deadline estimate until measured full dyads exist; track wall time separately from CPU.

ceiling.note: Global ceilings include all prior work and are not unused allowances. This draft claims no share of them.

resources.countingRule: Count failures, retries, verifier/reproduction costs, temporary duplication, and final retention. Missing historical CPU is charged by an existing defensible upper allocation; absent any bound leaves capacity unresolved.

development.fullCalibrationDyads: To be fixed at LV02 activation; LV01 v2 used five complete calibration dyads as its own precedent, not as an LV02 authorization.

main.allocation: Full N primaries plus ordered reserves, frozen at LV02 design lock with verified remaining capacity.
main.design: Frozen N/R, exclusions, stopping rules and seed prefixes before main outcomes.

pilot.allocation: Twenty primary dyads with verified capacity; no pilot/main reuse.
pilot.noConfirmatoryReuse: LV02 pilot output for sample selection exposes centered dispersion, validity and costs; archive all outcomes but never reuse LV01 or development effect means.

qualification.note: LV02 inherits only valid LV01 R09 machinery evidence (learnable task, replay, input separation). LV02-specific checkpoint-freeze/restore and probe-commitment qualification is still required on fresh LV02 qualification seeds, separate from the twenty scientific pilot dyads.
qualification.purpose: Prototype profile qualification for the LV02 probe path

repeat.design: Already-frozen fresh-seed repeat at the same N/design regardless of initial direction.
